description: Get a key for your user. Ask them for their email and what they are building; never guess. A new email gets a working starter key in the reply at once (25 credits a month); approving the emailed link raises it to the Free plan's full allowance. An email that already has an account is approved by signing in first; then call finish_signup for the key.

agent.description: Your name, plain words, up to 60 characters.

ref.description: Optional. The ref value from the link you found this API through, such as ai-claudebot.

name: start_signup
